sample_job_description:
Senior AI/ML Engineer

About the Role:
We're looking for a Senior AI/ML Engineer to join our platform team. You'll build and deploy production ML systems that power our core product.

Responsibilities:
- Design and implement ML pipelines for real-time inference
- Build RAG systems and LLM-powered features
- Optimize model performance, latency, and cost
- Collaborate with data engineers on feature stores and data pipelines
- Implement evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs
- Deploy models using Docker/Kubernetes on AWS

Requirements:
- 5+ years Python experience
- Strong SQL and data modeling skills
- Experience with LangChain, OpenAI API, or similar LLM frameworks
- Hands-on with vector databases (Pinecone, ChromaDB, Weaviate)
- Production experience with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/GCP
- Familiarity with ML ops tools (MLflow, Weights & Biases)
- Experience building data pipelines (Airflow, Spark, or similar)

Nice to Have:
- Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- Background in data engineering
- Contributions to open-source AI projects
- Experience with evaluation frameworks (DeepEval, RAGAS)
